mapper.select: SELECT p.perms FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.perms != '' AND p.menu_type IN (2, 3)

SELECT ur.user_id FROM sys_role_permission rp INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE rp.permission_id = #{permissionId}
